summary: Turn the manager-only vacation feed at /org/{orgId}/requests into every member's inbox, and put a real Request entity behind it: a member raises an access or question request against another member, the addressee answers or declines, and only the requester (or an admin) writes granted. Three new tables (Request, RequestMessage, RequestEvent) and one defaulted column (Organization.nextRequestNumber) carry it; every status write happens inside a transaction that re-read the row with FOR UPDATE, and the number is allocated under a lock on the organization row. The list endpoint composes two sections in one response — spec-01 Request rows and spec-10's unchanged vacation cards — under one status vocabulary, retiring the spec-10 pending/approved/rejected values on this endpoint and making an unknown value a 400. Overdue is derived per reading account's timezone and stored nowhere; no mail is sent by anything in this spec. IMPORTANT: this branch already carries a full implementation from earlier runs of this same spec (commits 481a165, 6f2dbb5, e17de7a, 2d802e9, 9afbcb4). Each task below therefore names the file that already holds the work and what remains to be proven, rather than asking for it to be written a second time.

buildFromZero: Nothing in this spec is unbuilt at HEAD. The honest zero-list, as of the base commit f06c7d8, was: the Request / RequestMessage / RequestEvent tables and the Organization.nextRequestNumber column; the whole write side of apps/api/src/requests (create, thread, four transitions, edit, reassign) where only a read-only vacation projection existed; packages/validation/src/requests.ts entire; the three capabilities in both unions; the 31 REQUEST_MESSAGES keys; the request detail route and its four client components; the new-request modal; the unconditional sidebar row and the redefined badge; and 41 test cases.

What remains for this run is verification and repair only: prove the 41 cases still pass on the current tree, and close whatever a later stage finds. Two named risks are unwitnessed by any case and are the most likely place for a defect to be hiding — the behaviour of the vacation section under type=access or type=question, and the 400 body shape for an unknown scope value (see risks).
